event: Nature Medicine publishes MAPP1 phase 3: MDMA-assisted therapy beat placebo-with-therapy on CAPS-5 in 90 patients with severe chronic PTSD.
key_number: 67% vs 32% no longer met PTSD criteria; p<0.0001

event: American Journal of Psychiatry publishes double-blind sham-controlled RCT of Stanford Neuromodulation Therapy (5-day accelerated iTBS) in treatment-resistant depression.
Canada Gazette publishes SOR/2021-271, restoring Special Access Program requests for restricted drugs such as psilocybin and MDMA for patients with serious conditions.
DEA proposes placing five tryptamine hallucinogens (4-OH-DiPT, 5-MeO-AMT, 5-MeO-MiPT, 5-MeO-DET, DiPT) in Schedule I.
FDA alerts health care professionals to potential risks of compounded ketamine nasal spray products.
DEA withdraws its proposed Schedule I placement of five tryptamines after hearing requests and says it will seek a new HHS scientific evaluation.
Karuna reports positive phase 3 EMERGENT-2: KarXT beat placebo on PANSS total score at week 5 in acute schizophrenia.
FDA approves Auvelity (dextromethorphan-bupropion), the first oral NMDA receptor antagonist for MDD, with labeled symptom improvement from week 1.
key_number: first new oral MDD mechanism in 60+ years

event: DEA withdraws its April 2022 proposal to place DOI and DOC in Schedule I, citing an amended procedure.
FDA grants 510(k) clearance to Magnus Medical's SAINT Neuromodulation System (MRI-guided accelerated TMS) for MDD in adults who failed prior antidepressants.
key_number: ~80% remission vs 13% control in pivotal data

event: NEJM publishes Compass phase 2b: a single 25 mg COMP360 psilocybin dose beat 1 mg control on MADRS at week 3 in 233 TRD patients.
key_number: -6.6 MADRS vs 1 mg at week 3; p<0.001

event: Colorado voters approve Proposition 122 (Natural Medicine Health Act), decriminalizing five plant psychedelics and authorizing regulated psilocybin healing centers.
Relmada's esmethadone fails a second large phase 3 depression trial two months after the October 2022 RELIANCE III miss; shares fall further.
OHA adopts final administrative rules implementing Measure 109 psilocybin services; license applications open January 2, 2023.
Oregon Psilocybin Services begins accepting applications for manufacturer, service center, facilitator and laboratory licenses.
TGA announces final decision to reschedule psilocybin (TRD) and MDMA (PTSD) to Schedule 8 for TGA-authorised psychiatrists, effective 1 July 2023.
DEA publishes proposed rules on telemedicine prescribing of controlled substances after the COVID PHE, including in-person visit requirements and 30-day limits.
atai lays off about 30% of staff and reviews its pipeline two months after the PCN-101 (R-ketamine) phase 2a miss.

entity: Sens. Booker and Paul; Reps. Mace and Dean
event: Breakthrough Therapies Act reintroduced to let DEA move FDA breakthrough-designated Schedule I drugs such as MDMA and psilocybin to Schedule II; bill later dies in committee.
Synthesis Institute, a psilocybin retreat operator and Oregon's largest facilitator-training program, confirms bankruptcy after running out of funding.
Ketamine Wellness Centers, a Delic Holdings subsidiary, abruptly shuts all of its ketamine clinics across nine states.
Karuna reports positive phase 3 EMERGENT-3, its third positive registrational KarXT trial; NDA planned for mid-2023.
key_number: PANSS -8.4 points vs placebo at week 5; p<0.0001

event: Field Trip Health & Wellness obtains CCAA creditor protection from the Ontario Superior Court; PwC named monitor and a sale process starts.
Oregon issues its first psilocybin service center license (EPIC Healing Eugene); first client sessions follow in June 2023.
First temporary extension of COVID-19 telemedicine flexibilities for controlled medications through November 11, 2023, with a grace period to November 11, 2024 for existing relationships.
Governor signs SB23-290 (Natural Medicine Regulation and Legalization), creating the licensing framework for natural medicine facilitators and businesses.
NEJM publishes ELEKT-D: subanesthetic IV ketamine was noninferior to ECT in 403 nonpsychotic treatment-resistant depression patients.
FDA issues draft guidance 'Psychedelic Drugs: Considerations for Clinical Investigations' (docket FDA-2023-D-1987); comments due August 25, 2023.
Rescheduling takes effect: authorised psychiatrists may prescribe MDMA for PTSD and psilocybin for treatment-resistant depression in Australia.
Wesana Health closes the sale of its SANA-013 assets, completing its exit from the psychedelics business.
Neurolief reports a positive interim analysis of its MOOD pivotal trial of at-home Relivion neuromodulation in major depression.
key_number: interim analysis positive (effect sizes not captured)

event: FDA approves Zurzuvae (zuranolone) as the first oral treatment for postpartum depression and issues a CRL for the MDD indication, requiring more studies.
Compass Pathways raises $285M in a private placement to fund the COMP360 phase 3 program.
HHS recommends to DEA that marijuana be moved from Schedule I to Schedule III of the Controlled Substances Act.
source_org: Ohio State Moritz College of Law (DEPC)

event: JAMA publishes Usona's phase 2 PSIL201: a single 25 mg psilocybin dose beat niacin control at day 43 in 104 adults with MDD.
Nature Medicine publishes confirmatory phase 3 MAPP2 of MDMA-assisted therapy in moderate-to-severe PTSD; NDA filing follows.
key_number: 71.2% vs 47.6% no longer met PTSD criteria; remission 46.2% vs 21.4%

event: Neumora completes a $250M IPO to fund late-stage navacaprant depression trials.
NEJM publishes ESCAPE-TRD: esketamine nasal spray beat quetiapine XR on remission at week 8 in TRD across 171 sites in 24 countries.
Newsom vetoes SB 58, which would have decriminalized psilocybin and other plant psychedelics, citing the need for dosing and patient-protection guidelines first.
Second temporary extension of telemedicine flexibilities for controlled medications through December 31, 2024.
FDA warns patients and providers about risks of compounded ketamine products, including oral formulations used at home for psychiatric disorders via telemedicine.
FDA approves Spravato labeling supplement S-012 (package insert update).
Venture studio Beckley Waves acquires ketamine telehealth company Nue Life after Nue Life's standalone model faltered.
Cybin reports positive phase 2 topline for deuterated psilocybin analog CYB003 in MDD with no treatment-related serious adverse events.
key_number: 79% remission at 6 weeks after two 12 mg doses

event: DEA again proposes placing DOI and DOC (phenethylamine research hallucinogens) in Schedule I.
MindMed reports positive phase 2b of MM120 (LSD) in GAD with dose-dependent HAM-A improvement at week 4; 100 µg later showed 65% response and 48% remission at week 12.
key_number: 100 µg: 7.7-point HAM-A improvement vs placebo at week 4 (p=0.0004); n=198

event: Bristol Myers Squibb agrees to acquire Karuna Therapeutics, adding KarXT ahead of its FDA decision.
FY2024 NDAA signed with Section 723: $10M and a DoD process for service members with PTSD or TBI to join trials of psilocybin, MDMA, ibogaine, 5-MeO-DMT and plant-based therapies.
atai makes a $50M strategic investment in Beckley Psytech, taking a minority stake in the 5-MeO-DMT developer.
VA issues a request for applications to fund research on MDMA, psilocybin and other psychedelics for PTSD and depression, its first such funding in about six decades.
MAPS PBC rebrands as Lykos Therapeutics and raises a $100M Series A ahead of its MDMA NDA review.
Nature Medicine publishes Stanford's open-label magnesium-ibogaine study in 30 special-operations veterans with TBI, showing large drops in PTSD, depression, anxiety and disability.
key_number: n=30; one-month reductions ~88% PTSD, ~87% depression, ~81% anxiety

event: FDA accepts Lykos's NDA for midomafetamine (MDMA)-assisted therapy for PTSD with priority review; PDUFA date set for August 11, 2024.
FDA grants Breakthrough Therapy designation to MM120 (LSD D-tartrate) for generalized anxiety disorder.
FDA grants Breakthrough Therapy Designation to CYB003 for adjunctive treatment of MDD; Cybin reports positive four-month durability data.
FDA grants Breakthrough Therapy designation to CYB003 (deuterated psilocybin analog) as adjunctive treatment for major depressive disorder.
Cybin closes an oversubscribed $150M private placement to fund CYB003 phase 3 and CYB004 development.
Usona launches phase 3 uAspire: single 25 mg psilocybin dose vs placebo in about 240 adults with MDD, 6-week blinded period and 1-year follow-up.
SB 266 becomes law without the governor's signature, allowing large Utah health systems to run a psilocybin and MDMA treatment pilot.
ICER draft evidence report finds evidence on MDMA-assisted psychotherapy for PTSD insufficient because of functional unblinding and trial-conduct concerns.
FDA clears NeuroStar TMS as a first-line adjunct for MDD in adolescents aged 15 to 21, the first TMS clearance for this age group.
EMA holds a multi-stakeholder workshop 'Psychedelics: towards an EU regulatory framework' on clinical development and access.
DOJ publishes proposed rule to transfer marijuana from Schedule I to Schedule III of the Controlled Substances Act.
J&J reports phase 3 MDD3001: adjunctive seltorexant met all primary and secondary endpoints in MDD with insomnia symptoms.
key_number: primary MADRS endpoint met at day 43

event: FDA Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee votes against MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD, citing functional unblinding, missing safety data and site misconduct.
Advisory committee votes 2-9 that MDMA-assisted therapy is not shown effective for PTSD and 1-10 that benefits do not outweigh risks.
DEA stays the June 10, 2024 administrative hearing on Schedule I placement of DOI and DOC; the proposal remains pending.
Done Global CEO Ruthia He and clinical president David Brody are arrested on federal charges over an alleged $100M Adderall telehealth distribution scheme.
ICER final report: panel votes 14-1 that evidence is inadequate to show net health benefit of MDMA-assisted psychotherapy vs no MDMA-AP, and 15-0 vs trauma-focused therapy.
FDA issues a complete response letter (dated August 8) for MDMA capsules for PTSD, requesting an additional Phase 3 trial and citing safety and data-integrity concerns.
FDA issues a Complete Response Letter for MDMA-assisted therapy in PTSD and asks Lykos to run an additional phase 3 trial.
Psychopharmacology retracts three MDMA-assisted therapy papers by MAPS/Lykos authors over protocol violations and unethical conduct at the MP4 Canadian site.
Neuronetics agrees an all-stock merger with Greenbrook TMS, the largest US TMS clinic network; Neuronetics stock falls on the news.
MindMed closes a $75M public offering, bringing 2024 gross equity raises to about $250M after the $175M March 2024 offering and placement.
Lykos cuts about 75% of its roughly 100 staff after the CRL and retractions; founder Rick Doblin leaves the board; David Hough named senior medical adviser.
DEA publishes notice of an administrative hearing on the proposed marijuana rescheduling, initially set for December 2, 2024.
Lykos CEO Amy Emerson steps down; COO Michael Mullette becomes interim CEO and David Hough chief medical officer.
MHPAEA final rule published (released September 9): NQTL comparative-analysis and meaningful-benefit requirements, effective November 22, 2024, applicable plan years 2025 and 2026.
FDA approves Cobenfy (xanomeline-trospium), the first muscarinic agonist for schizophrenia and first new mechanism since clozapine.
key_number: first new schizophrenia class in ~35 years

event: Alto's biomarker-selected phase 2b of ALTO-100 in MDD misses its primary MADRS endpoint; shares plunge about 70%.
Compass delays COMP005 topline to Q2 2025 and COMP006 data to after the 26-week point (H2 2026) to protect blinding, and lays off 30% of staff.
FDA approves Spravato labeling supplement S-015 (package insert revision).
Massachusetts Question 4, a regulated natural psychedelics measure, fails with 43.1% yes and 56.9% no.
AbbVie's muscarinic agonist emraclidine, acquired via the $8.7B Cerevel deal, fails both phase 2 EMPOWER schizophrenia trials on PANSS.
Numinus agrees to sell its five Utah wellness clinics to Stella MSO and pivots to a data and technology model.
Cybin reports 12-month phase 2 follow-up for CYB003 in MDD with sustained response and no new safety signals.
key_number: 71% remission and 100% response at 12 months (two 16 mg doses); ~23-point MADRS drop

event: Third temporary extension of telemedicine flexibilities for controlled medications through December 31, 2025.
VA awards up to $1.5M over five years for its first VA-funded psychedelic study: MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD and alcohol use disorder at Providence and West Haven VAs.
VA announces funding for its first study of MDMA-assisted therapy in decades, for veterans with PTSD and alcohol use disorder.
CY2025 PFS final rule published; CMS keeps telehealth policies under its own authority (audio-only, virtual supervision) while statutory Medicare telehealth flexibilities await Congress.
Neuronetics completes the Greenbrook TMS merger, becoming a vertically integrated TMS device and clinic operator.
Relmada halts its two remaining phase 3 trials of esmethadone after a futility signal and explores strategic alternatives.
Numinus closes the sale of its US clinics to Stella and launches a data-sharing partnership.
key_number: US$2.08M cash at close plus installments

event: Colorado begins accepting natural medicine business license applications; the regulated program launches January 1, 2025.
FDA approves Spravato REMS modification S-013.
Neumora's phase 3 KOASTAL-1 of kappa-opioid antagonist navacaprant in MDD misses its primary MADRS endpoint; shares sink.
key_number: primary MADRS endpoint not met (80 mg)

event: Billionaire investor Antonio Gracias moves to take control of Lykos with about $100M of funding, backed by MAPS founder Rick Doblin.
DEA's chief ALJ cancels the January 21, 2025 marijuana rescheduling hearing pending an interlocutory appeal; the proceeding stalls.
source_org: Ohio State Moritz College of Law (DEPC)

event: J&J agrees to acquire Intra-Cellular Therapies (Caplyta) in its largest neuroscience deal.
Five Lykos board directors depart as the company seeks new funding after the FDA rejection.
DEA publishes proposed rule creating special registrations for telemedicine prescribing of controlled substances; comments closed March 18, 2025 with 6,400+ received.
Final rules allow a six-month buprenorphine supply via audio-only telemedicine and continuity of care via telemedicine for VA patients.
ERIC sues in D.D.C. to vacate parts of the 2024 MHPAEA final rule as arbitrary, capricious and beyond statutory authority.
FDA approves Spravato (esketamine) as monotherapy for adults with treatment-resistant depression (Drugs@FDA S-016 action dated January 17).
FDA approves Spravato as the first monotherapy for treatment-resistant depression, based on the phase 4 TRD4005 study.
key_number: remission 22.5% vs 7.6% at week 4 in TRD4005

event: J&J Q4 2024 results show Spravato crossed $1B in annual sales for the first time.
GH Research reports its phase 2b of inhaled mebufotenin (5-MeO-DMT) GH001 in TRD met the primary endpoint with no serious adverse events.
key_number: -15.5 MADRS vs placebo at day 8 (p<0.0001); 57.5% remission

event: Alto reports a favorable interim analysis of its EEG-biomarker phase 2b of adjunctive ALTO-300 in MDD; sample expanded to ~200 biomarker-positive patients.
key_number: interim favorable; ~200 patients in final analysis

event: Neumora halts one navacaprant depression trial and redesigns the KOASTAL-2 and KOASTAL-3 studies after the KOASTAL-1 failure.
J&J stops the phase 3 VENTURA program of kappa-opioid antagonist aticaprant in MDD for insufficient efficacy.
DEA and HHS delay the effective date of the buprenorphine and VA telemedicine final rules to December 31, 2025 after an earlier delay to March 21, 2025.
FDA approves Spravato REMS modification S-018; the REMS still requires certified settings and 2-hour post-dose monitoring.
Colorado issues its first healing center license to The Center Origin (announced April 2, 2025).
Governor signs SB 219, the Medical Psilocybin Act (effective June 20, 2025): DOH program for PTSD, TRD, SUD and end-of-life distress; $1M program and $0.5M UNM research funds.
Phase 3 ARISE misses: adjunctive Cobenfy did not significantly beat placebo on PANSS at week 6 in schizophrenia patients on atypical antipsychotics.
Departments announce they will not enforce the 2024 MHPAEA final rule's new requirements until the ERIC litigation ends plus 18 months; the 2013 rule and statute still apply.
FDA approves Spravato REMS modification S-021: minor revision to the Patient Monitoring Form marking event-outcome fields as required.
Makary tells NewsNation the FDA will give psychedelic trial data 'an expeditious and rapid review' and says the establishment is not listening to doctors or patients.
Lykos completes the first close of a Series B co-led by the Gracias Family Foundation and CH Foundation, recapitalizing the company under new control.
atai agrees an all-share combination with Beckley Psytech, contingent on BPL-003 phase 2b success, plus a $30M private placement.
key_number: Beckley valued ~$390M; ~31% of combined company; $30M PIPE

event: Governor signs SB 2308 committing $50M in state matching funds for a consortium to run FDA-track ibogaine clinical trials for opioid use disorder, TBI and PTSD.
Supernus agrees to acquire Sage Therapeutics (Zurzuvae) after Sage rebuffed Biogen's January 2025 offer.
Compass shares fall sharply as investors judge the 3.6-point COMP005 effect size modest despite statistical significance.
Compass reports phase 3 COMP005 met its primary endpoint: a single 25 mg COMP360 dose beat placebo on MADRS at week 6 with no suicidality imbalance.
key_number: -3.6 MADRS vs placebo (95% CI -5.7 to -1.5); p<0.001

entity: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
event: At a House Energy and Commerce hearing, Kennedy says HHS is 'working very hard' to make clinical psychedelic therapy available 'within 12 months'.
Cybin announces a financing of up to $500M in convertible debentures to fund its CYB003 phase 3 PARADIGM program.
Phase 2b of single-dose intranasal BPL-003 (5-MeO-DMT) in TRD meets primary and all key secondary endpoints; 8 mg dose advances toward phase 3.
key_number: n=193; 8 mg and 12 mg met primary MADRS endpoint at day 29

event: Czech Senate gives final approval to a law allowing medical use of psilocybin from January 1, 2026, the first national framework in the EU; sent to President Pavel for signature.
BfArM approves the EU's first compassionate use programme for psilocybin in treatment-resistant depression at ZI Mannheim and OVID Clinic Berlin, supplied by Filament Health.
FDA advisory committee votes against brexpiprazole plus sertraline for PTSD, citing inconsistent efficacy across the two phase 3 trials.
FDA approves Spravato REMS modification S-024.
Lykos names former Point72 capital markets head Nick McEntire as president under the Gracias-led ownership.
Lykos Therapeutics rebrands as Resilient Pharmaceuticals following the Gracias-led recapitalization.
FDA publicly releases the Lykos MDMA complete response letter, citing unreported adverse events at sites, weak durability evidence and possible selection bias.
FDA publicly releases the August 2024 Lykos CRL, detailing concerns on safety reporting, durability of response and functional unblinding.
key_number: CRL made public 13 months after issue

event: JAMA publishes MindMed's phase 2b of MM120 in GAD, the first placebo-controlled dose-response trial of LSD in an anxiety disorder.
key_number: n=198; 100 µg and 200 µg significant vs placebo at week 4

event: FDA clears BrainsWay's accelerated Deep TMS protocol for MDD, shortening treatment courses for adults.
Phase 3 MDD3005 misses its primary endpoint: seltorexant showed only numerically higher response than quetiapine XR in MDD with insomnia symptoms.
FDA issues a CRL for brexpiprazole plus sertraline in PTSD, citing insufficient evidence of effectiveness.
Medicare telehealth flexibilities lapse with the government shutdown; pre-pandemic originating-site limits and in-person mental health visit rules return for about six weeks.
FDA approves Spravato REMS modification S-025 with vendor-related changes to the REMS program website.
A wrongful-death lawsuit is filed against at-home ketamine provider Mindbloom over a North Carolina patient's overdose death.
MindMed closes an upsized underwritten public offering after positive phase 3 planning, extending runway into 2028.
VA expands psychedelic research to nine VA facilities studying MDMA and psilocybin for PTSD, treatment-resistant depression and anxiety disorders.
atai and Beckley Psytech complete their combination to form AtaiBeckley; a $150M October 2025 offering funds operations into 2029.
key_number: Beckley holders ~28% of combined company; $150M offering

event: CY2026 PFS final rule published: in-person visit within 12 months required for telehealth mental health care, telehealth list streamlined, digital mental health treatment payment expanded.
FDA approves Caplyta (lumateperone) as adjunctive treatment for MDD based on two positive phase 3 trials (studies 501 and 502).
H.R. 5371 signed, ending the shutdown and restoring Medicare telehealth flexibilities retroactively through January 30, 2026.
FDA clears BrainsWay Deep TMS as an adjunct for MDD in adolescents aged 15 to 21.
A federal jury convicts Done founder Ruthia He and clinical president David Brody in the Adderall telehealth fraud case.
CMS OPPS final rule keeps 2026 hospital outpatient payment stable for SAINT neuromodulation, supporting health-system rollout.
BMS delays the ADEPT-2 phase 3 readout in Alzheimer's disease psychosis to end-2026 after finding execution irregularities at a few sites; new patients to be enrolled.

entity: Sens. Booker and Paul; Reps. Dean and Mace
event: Freedom to Heal Act introduced to require a DEA registration pathway for physicians to administer MDMA and psilocybin to patients with severe, life-threatening conditions.
At the Medical Psilocybin Advisory Board's first meeting, DOH says patient access will launch by end of December 2026, a year ahead of the statutory deadline.
A federal grand jury indicts Done Global itself over the alleged $100M Adderall distribution scheme, exposing the company to at least $26M in fines.
Executive order directs the Attorney General to complete marijuana rescheduling to Schedule III expeditiously and tasks HHS, FDA, CMS and NIH with medical marijuana and CBD research.
Fourth temporary extension of telemedicine flexibilities for controlled medications through December 31, 2026, pending a final special registration rule.
Czech medical psilocybin framework takes effect: psychiatrists may administer psilocybin in approved facilities for TRD, cancer-related distress and other severe conditions.
Cybin rebrands as Helus Pharma and moves its US listing to Nasdaq under ticker HELP.
FDA lifts the clinical hold on GH001, clearing a global phase 3 program in TRD to start in 2026; shares jump.
MindMed rebrands as Definium Therapeutics (Nasdaq: DFTX from Jan 15) and guides to three phase 3 DT120 readouts in 2026.
FDA grants PMA approval to Neurolief's Proliv Rx, the first at-home brain neuromodulation therapy for adults with depression not adequately improved by antidepressants.
key_number: first at-home PMA-approved neuromodulation for MDD

event: UTHealth Houston-led IMPACT consortium (UTMB, Dell Med, Baylor and others) named for the SB 2308 ibogaine trials; private matching funds still required.
J&J full-year 2025 results show Spravato sales of about $1.7B, with Q4 2025 up 69% year over year after the monotherapy approval.
FDA approves Spravato REMS modification S-027, reverting the October 2025 vendor changes to the REMS program website.
FY2026 appropriations package signed, extending Medicare telehealth flexibilities for two years, through December 31, 2027.
Second phase 3 COMP006 meets primary endpoint: two 25 mg COMP360 doses 3 weeks apart beat 1 mg control on MADRS at week 6 in ~600 TRD patients.
key_number: -3.8 MADRS vs 1 mg; p<0.001; 39% achieved ≥25% reduction

event: Compass prices a $150M public offering the day after COMP006 topline; with warrant exercises, cash reaches $466M by March 31, 2026.
Alto closes a $120M private placement led by Commodore Capital at $20 per share, extending runway through 2029. (month precision)
AtaiBeckley reports a successful End-of-Phase 2 meeting with FDA for BPL-003 in TRD, keeping phase 3 initiation on track for Q2 2026.
Helus reports phase 2 signal-detection results for deuterated DMT HLP004 in moderate-to-severe GAD on top of standard of care.
key_number: ~10-point HAM-A improvement at 6 weeks (within-subject, p<0.0001); n=36

event: Neuronetics appoints Dan Reuvers as CEO as 2025 revenue nearly doubles after the Greenbrook acquisition.
In an ERIC v. DOL status report, the departments say they will no longer defend the 2024 parity rule and will propose replacement regulations by December 31, 2026.

entity: Texas Lt. Gov. Patrick and Speaker Burrows
event: Texas announces it will fund the $50M ibogaine trials itself through in-state institutions after no private partner met SB 2308's matching and revenue-share terms.
Alto's phase 2 proof-of-concept of ALTO-101 in cognitive impairment associated with schizophrenia misses its primary endpoint; shares drop.
Neuronetics' top shareholder says the company has 'chronically underperformed' and pushes for a sale review; a settlement follows in August 2026.
AtaiBeckley publishes phase 2a data of BPL-003 in TRD patients on SSRIs (CNS Drugs), showing rapid, durable response; BPL-003 holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation.
FDA approves Spravato REMS modification S-028 adding Spanish translations of REMS materials to the REMS website.
EO 14401 orders FDA priority vouchers for breakthrough psychedelics, an ibogaine right-to-try pathway, at least $50M for state programs and faster DEA rescheduling after approval.
Final order moves FDA-approved marijuana products and state-licensed medical marijuana to Schedule III (published and effective April 28, 2026); other marijuana stays in Schedule I.
FDA awards Commissioner's National Priority Vouchers to Compass (COMP360 psilocybin, TRD), Usona (psilocybin, MDD) and Otsuka/Transcend (methylone TSND-201, PTSD), enabling 1-2 month reviews.
FDA grants Compass a rolling NDA submission and review for COMP360 psilocybin in treatment-resistant depression; final submission targeted for Q4 2026.

entity: FDA / Compass Pathways, Usona Institute, Transcend Therapeutics
event: FDA awards Commissioner's National Priority Vouchers to Compass (COMP360), Usona (psilocybin) and Transcend (methylone), compressing review to about 1-2 months after NDA submission.
Makary says he expects an FDA approval decision on at least one priority psychedelic compound by late summer or fall 2026.
GH Research prices a $117.5M underwritten offering at $18 per share to fund the GH001 phase 3 program.
FDA approves Auvelity for agitation associated with Alzheimer's disease, the first non-antipsychotic approved for this indication.
Compass Q1 2026 update: rolling NDA sections already submitted, final submission targeted for Q4 2026, launch readiness by end-2026 and launch in H1 2027 pending approval and DEA rescheduling.
VA launches its MDMA-assisted therapy trial for veterans with PTSD and alcohol use disorder, the study funded in December 2024.
key_number: first VA-run MDMA trial in decades
source_org: The Center Square via Yahoo News

event: KOASTAL-2 and KOASTAL-3 both miss; Neumora discontinues navacaprant after three phase 3 failures and cuts 35% of staff.
Phase 3 Emerge of single-dose DT120 (LSD) ODT 100 µg in MDD meets its primary endpoint with rapid and durable effect and no serious adverse events.
key_number: -8.1 MADRS vs placebo at week 6 (p<0.0001; d=0.83); -14.2 at week 1; -7.3 at week 12

event: SB 43 becomes Act 956 without the governor's signature after unanimous votes, creating a psychedelic-assisted therapy pilot program effective August 1, 2026.
FDA approves Spravato REMS modification S-029 with updated REMS website workflows to make the portal more user-friendly.
Definium closes an upsized $805M public offering at $34 per share three days after the Emerge readout.
Helus completes a $50M underwritten offering, lifting cash to about $207M ahead of the APPROACH phase 3 readout.
OHA proposes fee increases for the psilocybin services program ahead of the September 1, 2026 merger of Oregon Psilocybin Services into the Oregon Medical Marijuana Program.
Expedited administrative hearing opens on broader rescheduling of marijuana, including adult-use products, from Schedule I to Schedule III.

entity: Reps. Luttrell, Correa, Bergman and McCaul
event: IBOGAINE Act (H.R. 9559) introduced in the House to advance ibogaine research and access.
COMP006 26-week (Part B) data show benefit of two 25 mg doses maintained on average through week 26 in nearly 600 participants.
key_number: 39% with ≥25% MADRS reduction at week 6, maintained to week 26

event: Done founder Ruthia He is sentenced to 72 months in prison and fined $90M for the Adderall telehealth distribution scheme.
FDA finalizes 'Psychedelic Drugs: Considerations for Clinical Investigations', setting expectations on trial design, therapist intervention, safety and long-term follow-up.
VA signs memoranda of understanding with HHS and FDA to expand psychedelic trial participation, train providers and share data under EO 14401.
FDA finalizes the guidance 'Psychedelic Drugs: Considerations for Clinical Investigations', three years after the June 2023 draft.
FDA announces a September 14, 2026 public hearing on future therapeutic use of psychedelic drugs in supervised settings (docket FDA-2026-N-7542); comments due October 6, 2026.
HRSA issues a request for information on training and care-delivery models for safe administration of potential FDA-approved psychedelics in ambulatory settings; comments due August 13, 2026.
J&J Q2 2026 results show Spravato sales of $584M, up 25% quarter over quarter and 40.8% year over year.
Lilly agrees to acquire AtaiBeckley for $6.75 per share cash plus a CVR of up to $2.50 tied to VLS-01 phase 3 start and BPL-003/VLS-01 approvals.
Helus completes enrollment in the phase 3 APPROACH study of HLP003 as adjunctive MDD treatment ahead of schedule; topline expected Q4 2026.
House passes FY2027 NDAA amendments extending DoD psychedelic clinical trials through September 30, 2033 and requiring a VA oversight official; rejects a Mace-Dean right-to-try amendment.
Helus Pharma appoints Michael Halstead as chief executive officer ahead of its pivotal HLP003 readout.
Collins says ibogaine is the VA's next psychedelic research focus during a Seattle VA Medical Center visit.
Resilient resubmits the MDMA-assisted therapy NDA for PTSD without a new phase 3, relying on VA long-term follow-up, a 32-subject cardiac safety study and a data audit; FDA opens a new review.
key_number: resubmission ~2 years after CRL; no new phase 3

event: Company resubmits its NDA for MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD (proposed brand Rysanso) without running the additional Phase 3 trial requested in the 2024 CRL.
Phase 3 Voyage of DT120 ODT 100 µg in GAD meets its primary HAM-A endpoint at week 12 with effect seen from day 2.
key_number: -5.4 HAM-A vs placebo (p<0.0001; d=0.81); 43% vs 16% ≥50% response

event: DEA sends its final telemedicine special registration rule to OIRA for review; the regulatory agenda targets final action in November 2026.
FDA grants Breakthrough Therapy Designation to DT120 (lysergide) ODT in MDD following the positive phase 3 Emerge results.
Compass reports 52-week open-label COMP005 data: participants who received an additional 25 mg dose in Part C kept improving out to one year.
key_number: mean 13-point MADRS reduction from baseline at week 52
source_org: Compass Pathways via Investing News Network

event: Eli Lilly completes its acquisition of AtaiBeckley, taking BPL-003 and VLS-01 into its neuroscience pipeline.
